summary: Unlinks node a1 from a doubly linked list whose prev/next links live at offsets 0x1E4/0x1E8: if a1's prev (a1+0x1E4) exists, patches prev->next (prev+0x1E8) to a1's next (a1+0x1E8); if a1's next (a1+0x1E8) exists, patches next->prev (next+0x1E4) to a1's prev (a1+0x1E4). If the list head dword_8B8F28 equals a1, the head is advanced to a1's next and that new head becomes the return value; otherwise the return value is a1. Called from audio-engine paths AudioEngineInitialization (0x00546010) and MutexSemaphoreCleanup (0x005461B0).

operations.description: Read the prev node pointer from a1+0x1E4 into v2.
Guard: only patch the prev link when v2 (prev node) is non-null.
Write a1's next pointer (a1+0x1E8) into the prev node's next field (prev+0x1E8), splicing this node out of the forward chain.
Read the next node pointer from a1+0x1E8 into v3.
Guard: only patch the next link when v3 (next node) is non-null.
Write a1's prev pointer (a1+0x1E4) into the next node's prev field (next+0x1E4), splicing this node out of the backward chain.
Guard: if dword_8B8F28 (list head) equals a1, this node is the head of the list.
Advance the list head: set result and dword_8B8F28 to a1's next pointer (a1+0x1E8), so the head becomes the following node.
Return result: the new head when a1 was the head, otherwise a1 itself.
